The issuer demonstrates robust profitability with a 65% gross margin and 23% operating margin, generating significant net income on a large asset base. However, the substantial debt load reflected in total liabilities of $84.8 billion and a weak current ratio of 0.53 indicate material leverage and liquidity constraints, characteristic of capital-intensive sectors. These factors balance out to an investment-grade rating in the lower-middle tier.

DECISION: BBB+
